newsitem.title: USA: CNB to make 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: CNB to make 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: CNB Financial Corp said Wednesday its board of directors had declared a three-for-two stock split.

The company said it would make the split in the form of a stock dividend payable on January 15 to shareholders of record on December 31. Shareholders will get one additional share for every two shares that they own, it added.
CNB, a bank holding company, said the split reflected its "solid" earnings performance for the year to date.

The company recently reported a fourth-quarter dividend of $0.17 per share and an additional special dividend of $0.12 per share. Cash dividends paid in 1996 totalled $0.79 per share compared with $0.72 in 1995, representing a 9.7-percent increase in cash dividends paid.
